snippet.title: Ectorider - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Ectorider's Demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5084420/Ectorider_Demo

Ectorider is a fast-paced 3D platformer combining Extreme Sports and Third Person Shooter. Fight a robot army with your super magnet or use them to do insane tricks with your rollerblades. Save the Ectomorphs and stop Professor Ecto's evil plan.

Original music by Matt Davies (Motherfountain): https://motherfountain.carrd.co/

Website: https://www.ectorider.com/
Twitter: https://x.com/EctoriderGame
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/ectorider.com
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ectoridergame/
Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@ectorider
